company_name: America West Airlines, Inc. / US Airways Group (post-merger)

fuel_consumption.source_quote: America West / US Airways merger completed September 27, 2005. AWA derivatives cover ~20% of combined US Airways Group 2006 fuel requirements (equivalent to ~68% of AWA's standalone portion). US Airways had no open fuel hedges.

instrument_type_details.notes: AWA's costless collar agreements cover ~20% of combined US Airways Group 2006 fuel requirements (equivalent ~68% of AWA's standalone portion). US Airways (East) had no fuel hedges. Net fair value = $4.0M (asset) at Dec 31, 2005. America West / US Airways merger completed September 27, 2005; combined entity operates as US Airways Group, Inc. This is AWA's final standalone CIK 706270 filing for FY2005.

throughput.source_quote: Fuel consumption (gallons in millions) [table]: 449 [2005], 450 [2004], 423 [2003]. Note: AWA/US Airways merger completed September 27, 2005; FY2005 figures reflect combined entity post-merger.

warnings: America West / US Airways merger completed September 27, 2005. Filing covers combined entity for partial year.
CIK 706270 used for US Airways Group from FY2005 onward; this is effectively the first combined-entity filing.
